title: Cosmic Eye and Mouse
description: A surreal scene features a large stylized eye dominating the right side, its pupil containing a dark mound with a crowned beetle and small human-like figures. In the lower left, a brown mouse stands on a circular golden platform surrounded by concentric ripples and small insect-like creatures.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork on black background showing a giant cosmic eye with purple and white swirling iris and sclera, inside the pupil is a black mound with a crowned beetle and tiny human figures, to the left a detailed brown mouse with long tail standing on an ornate golden circular platform with radiating lines and surrounded by concentric ripples and small insects, floating colorful symbols and geometric shapes around the eye, mystical and dreamlike atmosphere
